value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre has Tiny Gym for ages 1 to 3 with a parent, 45 minutes, and their site says fall registration opened July 22. Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre has Parent & Tot for 18 months to 3 years 11 months. I could not get into their pages today, so no day, time or price yet - I'll keep watching and text you when I have them.
